ActivityRow.description: One day's calls for one project, key, model and purpose.
ActivityRow.title: ActivityRow

AgreementOut.description: How often one judged check agrees with people on the answers they labelled (ADR 0017).
AgreementOut.title: AgreementOut

ApiTokenCreated.description: The only time the token itself is returned.
ApiTokenCreated.title: ApiTokenCreated

AppCallOut.description: One recorded call to an app for a test case (a conversation has one per turn).
AppCallOut.title: AppCallOut

AppTargetUpdate.description: Every field optional. Secrets are left as they are unless new ones are sent.
AppTargetUpdate.title: AppTargetUpdate

AppTestOut.description: Exactly what was sent and what came back, and what Verano could read from it.
AppTestOut.title: AppTestOut

CandidateRef.description: The improvement and candidate an experiment was made to test.
CandidateRef.title: CandidateRef

CaseAgreement.description: One model's repeated answers to one test case: `same` of `runs` match.
CaseAgreement.title: CaseAgreement

ComparisonOut.description:
How one set of results compares with another, case by case. `first` is the model (or the new version)
being asked about, `second` what it is compared with; `difference` is first minus second.
ComparisonOut.title: ComparisonOut

clearly_better_min_cases.description: Judged cases needed before two prompts can be called clearly different.
clearly_better_min_cases.title: Clearly Better Min Cases

proven_min_holdout.description: Held-back cases needed before an improvement can be called proven.
proven_min_holdout.title: Proven Min Holdout

ImprovementSummary.description: One earlier improvement in the history list: how it ended and which candidate did best.
ImprovementSummary.title: ImprovementSummary

JudgeCallOut.description: One call the judge was asked to make about an answer, exactly as it was sent.
JudgeCallOut.title: JudgeCallOut

JudgeChoice.description: The model that scores the judged checks, chosen on purpose and kept on the evaluator-set version.
JudgeChoice.title: JudgeChoice

LabelSummary.description: What people said about one answer: the majority and the split, and this user's own label.
LabelSummary.title: LabelSummary

ModelSetting.description: One model as the run was configured; `params` are the settings that reach the model.
ModelSetting.title: ModelSetting

ProvidedTaskSpec.description:
A Task Spec the user wrote (in `verano.yaml`, for example) instead of having a model draft it.
The inputs always come from the prompt itself, so they are not part of it.
ProvidedTaskSpec.title: ProvidedTaskSpec

Reason.description: Why a candidate is or is not proven better than the current prompt.
Reason.title: Reason

ReplicationOut.description: Did this experiment give the same answers as an earlier one with the same configuration?
ReplicationOut.title: ReplicationOut

RescoreRequest.description: Score again with the same checks, a given version of them, or the same checks judged by another model.
RescoreRequest.title: RescoreRequest

ReturnedModelOut.description: A model id the provider reported, and how many calls it answered (`id` is null when none was reported).
ReturnedModelOut.title: ReturnedModelOut

settings.description: What can be set, as plain text, for example 'values (list), case_sensitive'.
settings.title: Settings

RunConfiguration.description: What an experiment was set up with. `hash` is the same for the same configuration.
RunConfiguration.title: RunConfiguration

ScoringProgress.description: How far the judges have got: answers scored out of answers to score.
ScoringProgress.title: ScoringProgress

SharedCredentialOut.description: A key already added in another project of the same organization, which can be used here too.
SharedCredentialOut.title: SharedCredentialOut

TryJudgeRequest.description: Run one judged check on one stored answer, to see what the judge says before scoring everything again.
TryJudgeRequest.title: TryJudgeRequest

VariableMappingRequest.description: Which column of a table of inputs fills which prompt variable (or app input), one test case per row.
VariableMappingRequest.title: VariableMappingRequest

VerdictOut.description: The evidence behind a candidate's outcome: the holdout comparison and the plain-words conclusion.
VerdictOut.title: VerdictOut

VersionComparisonOut.description:
Two finished experiments side by side, usually two prompt versions on the same test cases: per model,
the quality difference with the usual "clear difference" rule, and which cases got fixed or broken.
VersionComparisonOut.title: VersionComparisonOut
